spotlight.heading: ## 🔍 Spotlight: Cross-agent MCP compatibility
spotlight.body: If you use more than one coding agent, MCP servers are the fastest way to keep the same tools across setups. Official reference servers and clean npm packages behave almost identically across Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor and Pi once slow npm downloads are cached ahead of time. Browse every server tested in all five agents on [Best MCP servers](/best/mcp-servers/) or our [Cursor MCP guide](/guides/best-mcp-servers-cursor/).

evergreen_section.heading: ## 🧭 Why one bad night does not mark a tool broken
evergreen_section.body: A single failed install in a clean sandbox can come from a registry blip or a slow package host. That is why SkillMaxx retries every failure once in a fresh container, labels flip-floppers as flaky, and waits for two bad nights in a row before calling anything broken. Full rules: [flaky vs broken installs](/guides/flaky-vs-broken/).
